Class JsonUtils

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.shared.utils.JsonUtils
public class JsonUtils extends Object
Utility class for JSON-related operations in the Galaxy Truckers project. Provides helper methods to convert JSON nodes to model objects.

    • nodeToConnector

      public static Map<Direction, Connector> nodeToConnector(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode connectorNode)
      Converts a JSON array node representing connectors into a map of directions to connectors. The order of connectors in the array is assumed to be [UP, LEFT, DOWN, RIGHT].
      Parameters:
      connectorNode - the JSON node containing connector information as an array
      Returns:
      a map associating each direction with its corresponding connector
